svg.title: Рывковая тяга широким хватом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two phases of a snatch PULL from the floor, three-quarter front view. One straight weighted barbell. Hands very widely spaced well outside shoulders, almost to end sleeves, BOTH arms remain straight. LEFT start: plates sit directly on floor, athlete bends knees and hips with straight neutral back and wide snatch grip. RIGHT finish of explosive extension: hips and knees fully extended, athlete tall on balls of feet with heels CLEARLY raised, shoulders shrugged up toward ears, straight arms hold bar close to upper thighs. No overhead catch, no biceps curl, no high-pull bent elbows. Distinguish this pull from ordinary deadlift with clear raised heels and shrug. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
